phaseAndVoiceContract.status: Authoring/export contract only; no Unreal implementation or device acceptance yet
phaseAndVoiceContract.timing: Audio uses wall-clock seconds, independent of 1x/3x/5x simulation speed
phaseAndVoiceContract.phases: Intro once, whole-file loop while currently eligible. Town normal warning end may use its coast-down outro. Vehicle outro can be scheduled only while response remains active; arrival/inactive eligibility loss cancels within 100 ms instead of lingering through a long ending. Blend phase changes over 40 ms with complementary linear gains.
phaseAndVoiceContract.interruption: Mute, pause, menu, city switch/load, suspend or destruction cancel eligibility and fade active components within 100 ms. Do not play the long town coast-down on interrupted or stale events. Restoring an eligible existing response/warning fades directly into Loop without replaying Intro or an onset notification.
phaseAndVoiceContract.town: One city warning voice. Start/stop from actual current warning eligibility; preserve D57 once-per-event guards when replacing its presentation. Normal warning end can coast down; interruption stops promptly.
phaseAndVoiceContract.vehicles: Only actively responding crews. Parked/inactive crews stay silent. Use a bounded pooled set of city-relative spatial components; no ticking audio actor per vehicle/building/citizen.
phaseAndVoiceContract.accentEligibility: Only relevant passing/traffic/proximity encounters during actual response. Randomize eligible encounters with cooldown and no immediate retrigger. No free-running random sirens.
phaseAndVoiceContract.accentMix: Police alternate replaces/crossfades the current police cadence rather than layering two full sirens. Fire horn may overlay with primary gain reduced to 0.5 during the accent, with 40 ms attack and 150 ms recovery. Global accent voices capped at two.
phaseAndVoiceContract.spatial: Dry mono source assets. Game owns location, attenuation, board transforms, listener/focus and mixing. Do not bake Doppler/reverb/distance into exports.
phaseAndVoiceContract.controls: Apply saved effects volume/mute after source gain and phase/duck envelopes. Ambience/music mixing is separate future scope.
phaseAndVoiceContract.integrationChecks: Import PCM16 runtime copies; verify exact duration/rate/mono, whole-wave loops, phase switching and cancellation in Unreal. Test active/inactive crews, eligibility/cooldown, 1x/3x/5x, load/switch/menu/pause/suspend, saved controls, dense simultaneous responses and Desktop/PCVR/Quest localization/fatigue/cost.

requiredLogicalControls: Restore existing eligibility directly to Loop
metaSoundIntegrationNotes.ownership: C++ owns authoritative eligibility, event identity/session deduplication, transforms, pools and saved controls; MetaSounds own waveform/phase/gain presentation
metaSoundIntegrationNotes.timing: Wall-clock audio at unchanged sample/playback rate for 1x/3x/5x simulation speed
metaSoundIntegrationNotes.loopIdentity: Preserve exact full-wave frame bounds/durations; notably Fire-Loop is 50 seconds, Town-Loop 20, Police-Loop 4 and Ambulance-Loop 2

eventAndSpatialPolicy.sirens: Use actual active police/fire/ambulance response identities/positions; parked/inactive crews stay quiet. Town uses actual current warning eligibility/onset/end.
eventAndSpatialPolicy.trafficAccents: Only relevant passing civilian vehicle/bystander encounters while responding, with the phase contract's bounded voices/cooldowns; no arbitrary global random sirens
eventAndSpatialPolicy.trafficPasses: Car-Pass/Truck-Pass follow relevant vehicle passages near the listener/focus, with bounded scheduling; offline scene timestamps are not runtime triggers
eventAndSpatialPolicy.activity: Fire-Crackle, Earthquake-Rumble, Construction-Tap, Demolition-Impact and Industry-Clank follow actual appropriate activity/events; no continuously ticking building sound Actors
eventAndSpatialPolicy.ambience: Area envelopes and zoom/focus drive selected local beds; broad distant mix remains quieter. Weather/day-night/season/location and actual city activity gate suitability. No ticking actor per building/citizen.
eventAndSpatialPolicy.wildlife: Schedule a small bounded pool of varied bird one-shots and suitable night-insect beds. Use natural timing variation at wall-clock speed, not simulation-speed replay.
eventAndSpatialPolicy.weather: Weather intensity, location/climate/season/day-night suitability choose wind/rain/roar/wildlife; thunder is a bounded storm event, not a repeated onset on every state poll
eventAndSpatialPolicy.notifications: New actionable transitions only, deduplicated across load/resume and rate-limited/coalesced at high simulation speed. Routine confirmation cues should be optional. Audio supplements visible state.
eventAndSpatialPolicy.transforms: Maintain emitters in city-relative coordinates and transform with board position/rotation/scale/current dimensions; define Desktop and VR listener/focus explicitly
eventAndSpatialPolicy.rendering: Dry mono assets; game owns spatialization/attenuation/listener policy. No source-baked pan/reverb/distance/Doppler. Use a small bounded pooled set, not Actors per building/citizen.
eventAndSpatialPolicy.ambienceBudget: Specific layer/voice budget remains an integration decision and measurement gate; only siren budgets have concrete proposed numbers in phaseAndVoiceContract
